What draws me to Kinsta is your focus on WordPress hosting for 230,000+ businesses. I've built WordPress sites end to end, including a ~600-page member profile build, so I understand the audience you're reaching. In the first weeks, I'd audit your current paid social campaigns and conversion tracking, then propose a testing roadmap for LinkedIn and Meta. I'd love to talk about how I can help drive sign-ups and revenue for Kinsta.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Kinsta team,

I recently ran a self-funded Google Ads test for a kids' bike brand in Belgium and the Netherlands. I built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords, and the campaign earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks. That test sums up how I work: hands-on, data-driven, and focused on turning ad spend into real customers. When I saw your Paid Media Specialist role, I knew I had to apply.

Kinsta's position as a top managed WordPress host for 230,000+ businesses, including agencies and enterprises, is exactly the kind of B2B audience I want to reach. I've built WordPress sites end to end, including a ~600-page member profile build for a pharmacists' association, so I understand the businesses and agencies that run on WordPress. I also track conversions in GA4 and Google Tag Manager, and I use that data to optimize targeting, bidding, budgets, and creative. I'm analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive, and I enjoy testing new ideas to scale what works.

In the first weeks, I'd audit your current paid social campaigns and conversion tracking, then propose a testing roadmap for LinkedIn and Meta. I'd also review your audience targeting and retargeting setup to find quick wins. I'd love to talk about how I can help Kinsta drive a consistent volume of sign-ups and revenue.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

I also run SEO and conversion-focused landing pages for e-commerce and B2B clients, and I build my own products with AI tools. I am analytical, detail-oriented and eager to learn, and I want to apply that ownership to paid social campaigns that drive sign-ups and revenue.
